title: Order Booking

provenance.note: landing state only (header stage); later stages not yet learned
provenance.also_observed: cnr2dev3 as KPO_slv, distributor 50000451, 2026-09-25: same fields; dsrType offers only Order Booker and Spot Seller; document date shown as dd-MM-yyyy

PJP.options_note: PJP codes of the environment, formatted '<code>-<name>'

Selling Category.note: empty until a PJP is chosen

Section.note: empty until a PJP is chosen

Outlet Name.note: empty until a PJP is chosen

Order Detail.note: appears only after an outlet is chosen; leads to the order lines stage

observations: The header stage shows no visible Next/Save button at landing; five icon buttons have no text (learn after choosing an outlet).
Document Date is read-only and fixed to today, so orders cannot be dated before/after a policy period from this screen (matters for TC46-48).
On cnr2dev3 as KPO_ph the dropdown data does not appear; on cnr1dev1 as KPO_mp it does.

cnr2dev3/KPO_slv: distributors offered 50000451-SATHENSOPIN, 50000598-SUPAMITR LV, 50000599-SUPAMITR LV. With 50000451 the PJP dropdown is populated (e.g. PJP14, RiazOB, 200311, 99999, RizwanOB, 110002), so Order Booking works there; with KPO_ph's distributors it does not.

cnr2dev3/KPO_slv/50000451 (2026-09-25 run 165111): PJP14-PJP14 -> Selling Category HPC -> Section14 -> Outlet 'C0000012520-ป้าA1' works; then the 'Order Detail' button (id orderDetail) appears. Document Date shows 25-09-2026 (dd-MM-yyyy) and is read-only.
flow: click Order Detail  (lines stage: to be learned)
